events.title: emergent_open_bioscience_breakthrough
events.description: The EU-led protein folding model is adopted by three national biosecurity agencies. It is slower than frontier systems but fully auditable, creating a niche for trusted, open science in high-stakes domains.

events.title: Verification Frontier Widens
events.description: A domain that was assumed to need a human to say whether the answer was any good turns out to admit a cheap automatic check – contract review, clinical coding, structural engineering, parts of law. Capability in that domain improves sharply within months of the check existing, and the argument that progress is confined to code and mathematics loses a piece of its territory.

portfolio.name: Open Science Resilience Initiative
portfolio.description: Establish a pan-European network of public research institutes and open-weight developers focused on high-assurance, auditable AI systems for biosecurity, climate modelling, and critical infrastructure resilience, with guaranteed deployment pathways into EU agencies and member state operations` — finished

portfolio.name: Sovereign Compute Backbone
portfolio.description: Establish a legally anchored, militarily protected, and publicly governed AI compute infrastructure on EU soil, capable of training and running auditable frontier-equivalent models independently of foreign providers` — in flight
